## Need
What real community need is being addressed?

## Proposed service
What useful action will be performed?

## Human owner
Who is accountable for the activity?

## Consent and privacy
How are participant dignity, consent, location privacy, and personal data protected?

## Evidence
What minimal evidence is appropriate without turning people into a score or exposing beneficiaries?

## Safety / legal considerations
Food safety, safeguarding, local requirements, funds, or other constraints.

## Success criteria
What observable outcome would make this useful?
